assertions.subject: Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: Thrombocytopenia is a condition where the platelet count is <150,000 platelets per microliter of circulating blood.

assertions.subject: Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: When the platelet count falls below 20 × 10^9/L, clinically important spontaneous hemorrhage occurs.

assertions.subject: Immune Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: Spontaneous microbleeds can frequently be seen in patients with platelet counts <30 × 10^9.

assertions.subject: Immune Thrombocytopenia
assertions.quote: CMBs occur more in ITP with longer duration and lower nadir platelet counts.

assertions.subject: Disseminated intravascular coagulation
assertions.quote: Fibrin-rich thrombi are seen pathologically in arterioles, capillaries, and venules.

assertions.subject: Disseminated intravascular coagulation
assertions.quote: The cause of mortality in DIC patients is multi-organ dysfunction and severe bleeding.
